```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyr)
library(vegabrite)
```

# Data
```{r}
ds<- fromJSON("https://calvin-data304.netlify.app/data/swd-lets-practice-ex-2-3.json")
head(ds)
```


# Data wrangling 
```{r}
ds_long <- ds |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(capacity, demand), 
               names_to = "type", 
               values_to = "value")

# Ensure that 'date' column is retained properly
str(ds_long)

# Convert 'date' to Date format
ds_long <- ds_long |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste0(date, "-01"), format = "%Y-%m-%d"))  # Adding day for proper conversion

# Check the structure of the new long format dataset
str(ds_long)


```

## Graphic 1

```{r}

vl_chart() |>
  vl_mark_bar() |>
  vl_encode_x("date", type = "nominal") |>
  vl_encode_y("value", type = "quantitative")|>
  vl_encode_xOffset("type")|>
  vl_encode_color("type")|>
  vl_add_data(ds_long)

```

```{r}
vl_chart(height = 400, width = 600) |>
  vl_layer(
    # Bar for Capacity (wider bars)
    vl_mark_bar(size = 30) |>
      vl_encode_x("date", type = "temporal", title = "Date") |>
      vl_encode_y("value", type = "quantitative") |>
      vl_encode_color("type") |>
      vl_filter("type == 'capacity'"),
    
    # Bar for Demand (default width)
    vl_mark_bar() |>
      vl_encode_x("date", type = "temporal", title = "Date") |>
      vl_encode_y("value", type = "quantitative") |>
      vl_encode_color("type") |>
      vl_filter("type == 'demand'")
  ) |>
  vl_add_data(ds_long)

```


```{r} 
#graph 3 ?
 vl_chart(height = 400, width = 600) |>
  vl_add_data(ds_long) |>
  vl_layer(
    # Bars for capacity and demand
    vl_chart() |>
      vl_mark_bar() |>
      vl_encode_x("date", type = "temporal", title = "Date") |>
      vl_encode_y("value", type = "quantitative", title = "Value") |>
      vl_encode_color("type", type = "nominal"),
    
    # Points for capacity and demand
    vl_chart() |>
      vl_mark_point() |>
      vl_encode_x("date", type = "temporal") |>
      vl_encode_y("value", type = "quantitative") |>
      vl_encode_color("type", type = "nominal")
  )
```
